security_onion._comment: Restricted SSH target. The server-side authorized_keys entry forces /usr/local/sbin/export-recent-alerts.

relay._comment: Runtime state paths on the Pi. These contain alert state and should not be committed.

webhook._comment: Normally enabled at runtime by relay_health_wrapper.py using /etc/so-alert-relay/relay.env.

pcap_broker._comment: Disabled until the n8n PCAP broker proxy workflow is imported, tokenized, active, and reachable from the relay VLAN.

filters._comment: Leave Pi-side rule filtering empty. Rule drops, suppression, routing, and reporting are owned by Mac Studio alert-store/n8n.
